policies.name: National Plastics Plan
policies.summary: Sets phase-out timelines for problematic single-use plastics including expanded polystyrene packaging, micro-beads in personal care, and PVC labels.

sources.publisher: Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water

newsFeed.headline: Australia's soft-plastic recycling restart adds 1,200 collection points
newsFeed.summary: After the 2022 collapse of the REDcycle scheme, a national restart has placed soft-plastic bins back into 1,200 supermarkets.

wooby.headline: Australia uses a lot of plastic — and is restarting soft-plastic recycling.
wooby.narrative: Wooby's friends on the Great Barrier Reef have seen plastic bags hurt sea turtles. Australia uses a lot of plastic per person, but recycles only a little. Soft-plastic recycling broke and is now starting again. Wooby is hopeful.

sources.publisher: Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water
